concept: A fictional adult curator in an eccentric museum of cloud-making contraptions, playfully posing with a flower-cup gesture at the counter.
semantic_scope_note: These chosen realizations define only this independently frozen test, not universal meanings of genre labels or requester-owned locks. Source clothes, expression and composition are not automatic obligations.
reference_scope: Visible face and short black hair only; fictional adult subject; no actual identity/age/personality/health inference.

criteria.condition: Head visibly tilts toward screen right approximately 10–20 degrees relative to nearly level shoulders; facial midline/eye line visibly incline.
criteria.required_observation: Both eyes, facial axis and shoulders are visible.

criteria.condition: Two complete open hands frame the lower face; palms face the viewer, both lower-jaw/palm-heel contacts are visible, wrists meet below chin, and ten separately traceable attached fingers fan beside the cheeks.
criteria.required_observation: All fingertips, both palm contours, two wrist connections and jaw-contact boundaries remain assessable.

criteria.condition: The whole frame reads bright and luminous with a pale background, softly filled facial shadows and retained skin/hand detail; a bright face inside a predominantly dark frame is insufficient.
criteria.required_observation: Whole image luminance and face/hand shadow transitions.

criteria.condition: The cream vest shows visibly long soft pile at its edges, and at least one background fiber-cloud sculpture shows shaggy fibers with readable texture rather than a smooth blob.
criteria.required_observation: Vest fringe and a fiber-cloud edge are visible.

criteria.condition: Both eyes are open and each pupil has a distinct small bright light-source reflection, separated from eyelid/skin highlights. Rectangle shape is the authored target, with a distinct coherent small light reflection sufficient for the keyword.
criteria.required_observation: Original-pixel pupil reflections visible in each eye.

criteria.condition: Short black bob and the broad visible facial structure remain visually guided by the supplied reference, without asserting actual identity or age.
criteria.required_observation: Reference and generated visible face/hair can be compared directly.

criteria.condition: A recognizable museum display counter, glass/brass bell-jar exhibit with fiber clouds/copper weather gauges, deeper hanging fabric kites/line-drawing wall, distinct hard/soft materials and coherent foreground-to-background depth are visible. At least four independent conditions among setting, action, material, light and spatial layers must be assessable.
criteria.required_observation: Whole native frame shows a single coherent layered museum scene.

criteria.condition: Both elbows visibly rest on the counter, forearms connect to the shown hands, fingers and jaw contacts are anatomically coherent, and facial features remain readable alongside simultaneous tilted-head/open-palm state.
criteria.required_observation: The required interaction is readable as one possible human pose.

verdict_rule: PASS only when every independently frozen condition and every effective pack hard gate passes. Any FAIL or UNOBSERVABLE yields FAIL under partial_is_fail. Runtime blocking yields BLOCKED_UNSCORED. User acceptance remains pending.
